achievement_survive_one_day.description: Survive for a day and find a safe place to sleep

achievement_survive_91_days.name: A time to every purpose under heaven

achievement_marathon.name: Pheidippides was a hack
achievement_marathon.description: Run a marathon… plus a little more.

achievement_walk_1000_miles.name: Please don't fall down at my door

achievement_vehicle_distance_skidding.name: I have full control of the car, I swear.

achievement_vehicle_velocity_rail_human5.name: The human body was not designed for this

requirements.description: Return to the location you started the game

achievement_cut_1_tree.name: Timber
achievement_cut_1_tree.description: If a tree falls in a forest and no one is around to hear it, does it make a sound?

achievement_cut_100_trees.name: Lumberjack
achievement_cut_100_trees.description: What is a forest for a man with an axe?

achievement_cut_1000_trees.name: Deforestation
achievement_cut_1000_trees.description: If you cut down the trees you will find the wolf.

achievement_exhume_1_grave.name: Grave Digger
achievement_exhume_1_grave.description: That's exactly what we need: more dead bodies.

achievement_exhume_10_graves.name: Grave Robber
achievement_exhume_10_graves.description: Hey, what if they turned down there?  You gotta check.

achievement_bury_1_corpse.name: Funeral
achievement_bury_1_corpse.description: It's a privilege to be buried when billions will not be.

achievement_bury_10_corpses.name: Undertaker
achievement_bury_10_corpses.description: Leave no one to rot among the living dead.

achievement_bury_100_corpses.name: Funeral House
achievement_bury_100_corpses.description: You cannot bury the whole world, can you?

achievement_install_1_cbm.name: Cyberpunk
achievement_install_1_cbm.description: Spiritus quidem promptus; caro vero infirma.

achievement_install_10_cbms.name: Clockwork Man
achievement_install_10_cbms.description: By most mechanical and dirty hand.  I shall have such revenges on you… both.  The things I will do, what they are, yet I know not.  But they will be the terrors of the earth.

achievement_crosses_mutation_threshold.name: Homo Evolutis
achievement_crosses_mutation_threshold.description: The world of man has ended.  Long live the world of transhumanity.

achievement_mutation_threshold_rat.name: At first I was afraid, I was petrified…

achievement_mutation_threshold_cattle.name: Don't drive a limousine, become it

achievement_mutation_threshold_cephalapo.name: How did I ever get surrounded by such undead neighbors?

achievement_mutation_threshold_troglobit.name: Spelunking: a lifestyle, not a hobby

achievement_mutation_threshold_gastropod.name: Carrying your home on your back

achievement_mutation_threshold_medical.name: What doesn't kill you, makes you stranger

achievement_break_major_limbs.name: Broken But Not Defeated
achievement_break_major_limbs.description: Does your medical insurance cover that?

achievement_lvl_10_speech.name: Silver Tongue
achievement_lvl_10_speech.description: Legend has it you convinced a zombie hulk to go away.

achievement_lvl_4_computer.name: Help Desk
achievement_lvl_4_computer.description: Have you tried turning it off and back on again?

achievement_lvl_7_computer.name: HackerMan
achievement_lvl_7_computer.description: This OS has a back door.  There is always a back door.

achievement_lvl_7_firstaid.name: MD
achievement_lvl_7_firstaid.description: Is there a doctor in the house?

achievement_lvl_10_mechanics.name: MacGyver
achievement_lvl_10_mechanics.description: This whole deal is holding on faith, spit, and duct tape.

achievement_lvl_7_traps.name: Trapper
achievement_lvl_7_traps.description: A good trap doesn't discriminate between beavers and zombeavers.

achievement_lvl_10_traps.name: Minesweeper
achievement_lvl_10_traps.description: All it takes is one mistake.

achievement_lvl_10_driving.name: The Stig
achievement_lvl_10_driving.description: Formula One is for Sunday drivers.

achievement_lvl_4_fabrication.name: Household Handyman
achievement_lvl_4_fabrication.description: If I have the instructions, I can make it work.

achievement_lvl_7_fabrication.name: Do-It-Yourselfer
achievement_lvl_7_fabrication.description: Take this thing, put it in that thing, and voila.

achievement_lvl_10_fabrication.name: Jack of All Trades
achievement_lvl_10_fabrication.description: With the right amount of glue, there is nothing I can't do.

achievement_lvl_10_cooking.name: Hell's Kitchen
achievement_lvl_10_cooking.description: Today's menu: Soupe a l'oignon, Boeuf Bourguignon, and Creme brulee.

achievement_lvl_7_tailor.name: Tailor
achievement_lvl_7_tailor.description: A needle, a thread, and a dream.

achievement_lvl_10_survival.name: Bear Grylls
achievement_lvl_10_survival.description: So you say you can survive on your own urine?

achievement_lvl_4_electronics.name: Shocking
achievement_lvl_4_electronics.description: One is positive, one is negative.

achievement_lvl_7_electronics.name: Ohm's Law
achievement_lvl_7_electronics.description: Thunder Ohm.  Two volts enter, one volt leaves.  Resistance is futile.

achievement_lvl_10_electronics.name: Nicola Tesla
achievement_lvl_10_electronics.description: One does not simply taste a 9 V battery.

achievement_lvl_10_launcher.name: Rocket Man
achievement_lvl_10_launcher.description: I'm sending you to the moon.  In pieces.

achievement_lvl_4_pistol.name: Pistoleer
achievement_lvl_4_pistol.description: Don't forget the one in the chamber.

achievement_lvl_7_pistol.name: Small But Deadly
achievement_lvl_7_pistol.description: Caliber doesn't count when you're on the receiving end of the barrel.

achievement_lvl_10_pistol.name: Dirty Harry
achievement_lvl_10_pistol.description: But being this is a .44 Magnum, the most powerful handgun in the world and would blow your head clean off, you've gotta ask yourself one question:  Do I feel lucky?  Well, do ya, punk?

achievement_lvl_4_rifle.name: Recruit
achievement_lvl_4_rifle.description: Point towards enemy and squeeze trigger.

achievement_lvl_7_rifle.name: Rifleman
achievement_lvl_7_rifle.description: This is my rifle.  There are many like it, but this one is mine.  My rifle is my best friend.  It is my life.  I must master it as I must master my life.

achievement_lvl_10_rifle.name: Soldier
achievement_lvl_10_rifle.description: Without me, my rifle is useless.  Without my rifle, I am useless.  I will keep my rifle clean and ready, even as I am clean and ready.  We will become part of each other.

achievement_lvl_7_shotgun.name: Double Barrel, Double Fun
achievement_lvl_7_shotgun.description: When you want to hit your target nine times with one shot.

achievement_lvl_7_smg.name: Spray'n'Pray
achievement_lvl_7_smg.description: One will hit.  It's a matter of statistics.

achievement_lvl_7_melee.name: Brawler
achievement_lvl_7_melee.description: Bottle in left hand, chair leg in right hand.

achievement_lvl_10_melee.name: Street Fighter
achievement_lvl_10_melee.description: It's winning that matters, not the style.

achievement_lvl_4_bashing.name: Batter
achievement_lvl_4_bashing.description: Every strike brings me closer to a home run.

achievement_lvl_7_bashing.name: Beater
achievement_lvl_7_bashing.description: If you beat them enough, they stay down.

achievement_lvl_10_bashing.name: Stone Age
achievement_lvl_10_bashing.description: Cudgel was humanity's first tool.  And it may be its last, so why not master it?

achievement_lvl_4_cutting.name: Edged Combat
achievement_lvl_4_cutting.description: Blades are one of man's most useful tools.  It was true then and it's even more true now.

achievement_lvl_7_cutting.name: Way of the Sword
achievement_lvl_7_cutting.description: When the sword is once drawn, the passions of men observe no bounds of moderation.

achievement_lvl_10_cutting.name: Miyamoto Musashi
achievement_lvl_10_cutting.description: The sword has to be more than a simple weapon; it has to be an answer to life's questions.

achievement_lvl_4_dodge.name: Avoidant
achievement_lvl_4_dodge.description: Better to move than to be still.

achievement_lvl_7_dodge.name: Elusive
achievement_lvl_7_dodge.description: The strongest of blows is nothing if it doesn't land.

achievement_lvl_10_dodge.name: Neo
achievement_lvl_10_dodge.description: But can you dodge a bullet?

achievement_lvl_4_stabbing.name: Precise
achievement_lvl_4_stabbing.description: I strike where I mean to.

achievement_lvl_7_stabbing.name: Cold Steel
achievement_lvl_7_stabbing.description: While you were partying, I studied the blade.

achievement_lvl_10_stabbing.name: Jack the Ripper
achievement_lvl_10_stabbing.description: Is this a dagger which I see before me, the handle toward my hand?  Come, let me clutch thee.

achievement_lvl_4_unarmed.name: Pugilist
achievement_lvl_4_unarmed.description: There is strength in my hands.

achievement_lvl_7_unarmed.name: Road to Shaolin
achievement_lvl_7_unarmed.description: I feel an army in my fist.

achievement_lvl_4_chemistry.name: Periodic Table
achievement_lvl_4_chemistry.description: I remember some of this from school.

achievement_lvl_7_chemistry.name: Chemical engineer
achievement_lvl_7_chemistry.description: It's somewhat like cooking.  Just don't lick the spoon.

achievement_lvl_10_chemistry.name: Heisenberg
achievement_lvl_10_chemistry.description: You all know who I am.  I'm the cook.  Say my name.

achievement_witnessed_portal_storm.name: Reality is falling apart
achievement_witnessed_portal_storm.description: You will be baked, and then there will be cake.

achievement_officer_kill.name: Killed the XEDRA officer
achievement_officer_kill.description: The haunting has finished and I am victorious.

requirements.description: Do you have a few minutes to talk about our lord and savior Jesus Christ?

achievement_reach_mid_z_level.name: I can see my house from here!

achievement_reach_mansion.name: Lifestyles of the rich and fetid!

achievement_reach_police_station.name: Zombie PD, to protect and zombify!

achievement_break_3_bones.name: That's not supposed to bend that way!

achievement_reach_highlands.name: Things betwixt
achievement_reach_highlands.description:
Along the shore the cloud waves break,
The twin suns sink beneath the lake,
The shadows lengthen
                       In Carcosa.

achievement_reach_string_dimension.name: String Theory
achievement_reach_string_dimension.description: Reach the dimension of sundered spacetime, and live to tell the tale.

achievement_LIXA_finale.name: Trigintaduonion
achievement_LIXA_finale.description: Defeat a being from a higher dimension, and free the damned souls trapped inside

achievement_exodii_hub_autodoc_death.name: Vespertilio Perfidus
achievement_exodii_hub_autodoc_death.description: He that is neither one thing nor the other has no friends.

achievement_reach_labyrinth.name: You don't by any chance know the way through this labyrinth, do you?
